summary: Synchronized the PH-232 frozen spec's coverage formula with the delivered PH-240 implementation, without touching any delivered implementation description, code, migration, test, whitelist or historical pass. The balance bullet now states: cash uncleared balance / available = posted gross_cents - sum(active cleared_cents) - sum(active refunds gross) - sum(active bank returns gross), while the OpenItem remaining formula stays gross - sum(active cleared) with the Offset extension slot at 0 (Offset is explicitly not claimed as implemented). The spec cites the real interfaces: cash refund_services.refund_coverage_for_cash returns cash_transaction_ref/refunded_cents/returned_cents/total_cents (total = refunded + returned)/offset_cents=0/offset_implemented=false; settlement clearance_coverage_for_cash returns cash_transaction_ref/posted_gross_cents/cleared_cents/offset_cents=0/total_cents(=cleared)/offset_implemented=false with no refunded field; create_clearance caps at gross - _cash_cleared - refund_coverage_for_cash(...)['total_cents']. A new bullet records the PH-241 contract item still to be synced: posted_cash_candidates/create_clearance must exclude advance-classified cash via the PH-239 classification read and one cash must never have both an active clearance and an active offset; PH-232's delivered behavior does not yet contain that exclusion, so the spec does not claim it is implemented. The golden sample, counterexamples and verify_integrity lines gained the refunded/returned deduction, the 'do not clear already refunded/returned amounts' case, and the PH-241 mutual-exclusion assertion as a post-PH-241 item. No product code, migration or runtime change.
